correctness.rationale: A derivation kills 1 and its generator images have no constants: differentiating x_i²x_j=0 for i!=j forces the constant coefficient of D(x_j) zero even in p=2,3. Write D on V⊕Sym²V as block [[P,0],[Q,S(P)]]. For odd p, D²(x_j²) quadratic component 2(Px_j)² forces P=0, Q unrestricted. In p=2, D² is a derivation and generator equation is P²=0 and S(P)Q+QP=0. A rank-r square-zero P comprises r doublets and t=d-2r singletons; induced S(P) has h=r(d-r) doublets and s=r+binom(t+1,2) singletons. Chain maps contribute q^(d h+r s) free parameters and arbitrary s×t homology map of rank k, full D rank r+h+k. This proves all strata and maxima. Independent exhaustive actual derivation matrices at d=2: q=2 spectrum 1+21T+66T²; q=3 spectrum 1+104T+624T². The all-d extension-field result is symbolic, not inferred from tests.
residual_risks: Finite exact enumeration is corroboration only; unrestricted theorem relies on the specified symbolic argument.
